title: fix: resolve CI build errors in types, console, and fields packages
body:
Three independent build failures on main: a type incompatibility in `ChatbotSchema`, a missing type assertion in `ObjectManagerPage`, and a bundled `react/jsx-runtime` breaking Next.js SSR.

- **`@object-ui/types`** — `ChatbotSchema.body: Record<string, unknown>` conflicts with `BaseSchema.body: SchemaNode | SchemaNode[]`. Renamed to `requestBody` since it represents HTTP request params, not child schema nodes.

- **`apps/console`** — `ObjectManagerPage.toFieldDefinition()` assigns `field.type` (string) to `DesignerFieldType` (literal union). Added type assertion and missing import:
  ```ts
  type: (field.type || 'text') as DesignerFieldType,
  ```

- **`@object-ui/fields`** — `react/jsx-runtime` was not externalized in vite config, causing it to be bundled into the CJS output. Next.js Turbopack SSR rejects the resulting dynamic `require()` during static prerendering of `/docs/components/overlay/tooltip`. Added `react/jsx-runtime` to externals, matching the pattern in plugin-list/plugin-detail.
